title: Reserve Bank of India (Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026 - Loan Recovery and Collection Practices
description: <cite index="45-1,45-2">RBI consolidated recovery-conduct standards applicable to banks, NBFCs and housing finance companies, including new definitions of recovery agencies, mandatory borrower compensation policies, and prohibition of device locking</cite>. <cite index="9-3">RBI requires lenders to document pre-escalation engagement steps and point borrowers at resolution options</cite>. <cite index="9-6">Recovery agents must hold certification from IIBF or an IIBF tie-up institute after completing the Debt Recovery Agents training programme</cite>.
